blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Oriental Mindoro Electric Cooperative, Inc. (ORMECO) has called on its power suppliers to immediately restore their full contracted capacity. It also warned that a significant supply shortfall may force the cooperative to implement manual load dropping on Saturday, Oct. 10. In its advisory, ORMECO said the province’s contracted capacity stands at 100.50 megawatts (MW), but only 63.05 MW is expected to be available Saturday— leaving a deficit of 37.45 MW.
